text:
Alex: Quick idea — propose a slim left rail IA: group Models, Datasets, and Workflows under a collapsible cluster called 'Assets'. Breadcrumbs show Workspace > Assets > Models > <ModelName>. Deep links would be /w/:workspace/assets/models/:id. How do we feel about a single cluster vs keeping separate top-level items?
Marta: I like grouping for density, but 'Assets' feels a bit vague. Maybe 'Resources' or 'Artifacts'? Also worried about discoverability for new users.
Ben: Accessibility nits: collapsed groups must expose aria-expanded and be keyboard toggleable. Header should be a real button so Enter/Space toggles. Also ensure the toggle announces new state to screen readers. Example: `<button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="assets-group">Assets</button>`
Priya: Copy nit: breadcrumbs should use canonical names — stick with 'Models' (not 'Model Registry'). And change small CTAs like 'Back' to 'Back to workspace' for clarity when deep-linking into nested pages.
DesignBot: Route mapping draft:
```js
const routes = [
  { path: '/w/:ws/assets/models/:id', handler: ModelPage },
  { path: '/w/:ws/assets/datasets/:id', handler: DatasetPage },
];
// legacy routes redirect to new paths with 301 for 3 months
```
Alex: Implementation concerns: keep legacy routes redirecting (301) for at least 3 months and log deep-link hits. We should A/B test label 'Assets' vs 'Resources' on a small % and monitor navigation success rate + support tickets. Rollback if 404 spike or big discoverability regressions.
Marta: +1 on telemetry. Also let's add a visible focus ring for group headers when keyboard navigating, and include a skip link to main content when the rail is persistent. We'll need NVDA/VoiceOver QA.
Ben: Edge case: saved searches and pinned routes with query params (e.g., `/w/:ws/models?filter=x`) must preserve queries when redirecting. Mobile: collapse to hamburger but deep links must still land on the correct content (no JS-only routing failure).
Priya: Tiny copy tweak suggestion for breadcrumb hover states: show full workspace name when truncated and add `title` attribute. Also prefer verbs in action links: 'Open model' vs 'View'.
Alex: I'll draft a short design doc + PR with route map, aria updates, and a small experiment plan. Ping me if you want to review — cc @Priya @Marta. Design doc link: https://redwood.design/console-ia-slim-rail
Marta: Sounds good — will add accessibility test cases to the doc.
Ben: I'll double-check redirects and query-preservation in the router implementation.
DesignBot: Reminder: add telemetry event `console.nav.deep_link` with `label` and `success` booleans for the experiment.
